Named providers validate names, reject case combinations and duplicates, and
cannot target selected types.
-- go.mod --
module app

go 1.26
-- main.go --
package main

import "os"

func main() { os.Exit(run()) }
-- cache/cache.go --
package cache

//fabrik:config cache
type Config struct {
	Kind string `yaml:"kind" default:"memory"`
}

type Mem struct{}

func (*Mem) Get(string) string { return "" }

//fabrik:provider name=warmpool
func NewWarmPool() Cache { return &Mem{} }

//fabrik:provider:select cache.kind
type Cache interface{ Get(string) string }
-- store/store.go --
package store

//fabrik:config store
type Config struct {
	Kind string `yaml:"kind" default:"memory"`
}

//fabrik:provider:select store.kind
type Store interface{ Get(string) string }

type Memory struct{}

func (*Memory) Get(string) string { return "" }

//fabrik:provider case=memory
func NewMemory() *Memory { return &Memory{} }

//fabrik:provider name=backup
func NewBackup() Store { return &Memory{} }
-- web/web.go --
package web

type DB struct{}

//fabrik:provider name=Read_Only
func NewBadToken() *DB { return &DB{} }

//fabrik:provider name=
func NewEmpty() *DB { return &DB{} }

//fabrik:provider name=spare case=memory
func NewBoth() *DB { return &DB{} }

type Cache struct{}

//fabrik:provider name=warm
func NewWarm() *Cache { return &Cache{} }

//fabrik:provider name=warm
func NewWarm2() *Cache { return &Cache{} }
